text.jp:
ねえ、お願いがあるんだけどさ。
一緒に戦わせてくれない？
text.official_en: Hey, quick question. Can I join up with you?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あたいの愛するダーリンはさ、強い人が好きなんだ。
だから、強くなりたいんだよ！
text.official_en:
I want to fight and get stronger. Sweetie loves strong
people best!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あんたといれば、鍛えられると思うんだよね。
絶対足は引っ張らないからさ。お願い！
text.official_en:
If I'm with you, I should be able to hone my skills.
Promise I won't let you down!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
本当！？　ありがとう！
仲間にしてもらったからには頑張るよ！
text.official_en: Really? Thanks! Like I said, I'm ready to work!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
こう見えて腕力には自信があるしさ！
漁だって得意だし、いろいろ頼りにしてよ！
text.official_en:
I may look like I grew up in a fishing village, because
I did. But I'm plenty strong AND can catch dinner!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こんなに頼んでるのに、なんだよ！
でも、あたいは諦めないんだからね！
text.official_en:
Come on! I really do want to get stronger, and I'll
give it my all. I'm here if you need me!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ

text.jp:
え……仲間になって欲しい？
あたいが？　あんたのクランの？
text.official_en: Uh, what? Join up with you? Me...in your clan?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
悪いけど、あたいはダーリン一筋なんだ。
諦めて、違う人を誘いなよ。
text.official_en:
Sorry, I'm devoted to my Sweetie, and that's that.
I won't be lured away.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あんたのクランに来ないか……って
それ、本気で言ってんの？
text.official_en: Will I join your clan? Are you serious?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あたいはダーリン……ディートリヒ一筋なんだ。
だから悪いけど、その話には乗れないね。
text.official_en:
I'm devoted to Sweetie—Dietrich, I mean. Sorry, but
you can't talk me into it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
うーん……どうしても、仲間になって欲しいの？
そこまで言われると、ちょっと嬉しいかも。
text.official_en:
Hmm. You want me to join you and you won't take
no for an answer? I'm a little flattered, I'll admit.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
わかった！　多分無理だろうけど、
１回だけ、あんたに機会をあげるよ。
text.official_en:
I see. Well, I don't know if this'll work out or not, but
you probably deserve a chance.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ

text.jp:
あたいの故郷はフィーナっていう漁村なんだ。
何にもないけど、いいところだよ。
text.official_en:
My hometown is a fishing village called Fina.
There's not much there, but it's a good place.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その近くの「ダマセン岬」って場所に
昔から気性の荒い海獣どもの巣があるんだ。
text.official_en:
Right nearby, you'll find Cape Damasen, where
there's a colony of aggressive sea beasts.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
地元の奴らは絶対近づかない、危ない場所さ。
そこにいる海獣をみんなやっつけてきなよ。
text.official_en:
Nobody from my village will go near the place, so
you'd be doing them a favor if you finished 'em off.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ま、あんたたちじゃ、絶対無理だろうけど。
もし倒せたら、仲間のこと、考えてあげる！
text.official_en:
You don't look like much, but if you can get it done,
I'll join up. I mean, how could I say no?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あの荒くれ海獣どもをやっつけたー！？
無理だと思ったのに……なかなかやるじゃん。
text.official_en:
You got rid of those sea beasts? I didn't expect much,
but...you're pretty good, aren't you?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
実は、最近あそこの海獣の数が
すごく増えてるって噂をきいてさ……
text.official_en:
Seems more and more of them have been making
the cape their stomping grounds lately.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ

text.jp:
フィーナにいる母さんが心配だったんだ。
でも、もうその不安もなくなっちゃった。
text.official_en:
I was worried about my mom back in Fina, but I
guess I don't have to anymore!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ

text.jp:
あんたの実力、それに、あたいへの想いが
嘘じゃないのは、よーっく伝わった。
text.official_en:
Well, you've made your point. You're strong, and you
did what it takes to show me that.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダーリン一筋なのは変わらないけど、特別に
あんたの戦いにも、手を貸してあげる！
text.official_en:
My heart is Sweetie's and only Sweetie's, but I'm
happy to lend you a hand in battle. You earned it!
